```yaml
name: Clean Unused Strings

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Run every Monday at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-unused-strings:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Detect unused strings
        id: detect-unused-strings
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings.json

      - name: Post comment with unused string count and details
        if: steps.detect-unused-strings.outputs.unused-string-count != '0'
        run: |
          echo "::add-comment::Unused strings found:"
          cat unused_strings.json

  clean-unused-strings:
    needs: check-unused-strings
    runs-on: macos-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Remove unused strings
        run: |
          python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: clean-unused-strings
          commit-message: "Clean unused localization strings"
          title: "Clean unused localization strings"
          body: "This PR cleans up unused localization strings detected by the automation."
```
